App.Title: PF2E Item Forge
App.Heading: Item Forge
App.Subtitle: One item, many knobs to turn.

Hints.EmptyRarityMeansAll: No selection means all rarities are allowed.
Hints.SolverAttempts: Maximum number of attempts value-based generators may use to find a result inside the requested value range.
Hints.EquipmentMode: Selects a non-specific base item from the chosen compendiums and applies a level-appropriate combination of fundamental runes.
Hints.PropertyRunesLater: Property runes will be added as a separate component block; this version already establishes level resolution and property-rune capacity.
Hints.PropertyRuneMode: Automatic fills available rune slots with level-appropriate runes; Random varies count and selection; Fixed uses only the selected runes.
Hints.NoPropertyRunes: No property runes are registered for this item type.
Hints.PropertyRuneCapacity: The actual number of property runes is limited by the potency rune value.
Hints.ScrollSources: For scrolls, spell compendiums are also offered as sources. The generic scroll is only a template; the generated item receives a suitable spell.
Hints.TreasureMode: Generates exactly one nonmagical sale or art treasure. Material, craftsmanship, and condition affect its value.
Hints.ValueTolerance: 0.15 means ±15% around the target value. If no match is found, the ValueSolver returns the closest valid result with a warning.
Hints.TreasureType: Optionally select one exact treasure type. “Any” lets Item Forge roll within the selected category.
Hints.MagicMode: Generates permanent special magic items such as wands, staves, spellhearts, and specific magic weapons and armor.
Hints.MagicSources: Selected compendia provide physical base items and, for spell-bound generators, the spell pool as well.
Hints.MagicTheme: Automatic chooses a theme with enough eligible spells. A selected theme is a hard constraint.
Hints.AllowHeightenedSpells: Only spells with actual heightening data may reappear at higher ranks in generated wands or staves.
Hints.StaffMode: Predefined copies an existing PF2e staff unchanged from the selected compendia. Generated creates a new thematic staff family using rules-style level profiles.
Hints.StaffProfile: The profile defines the levels of the base, greater, and major variants and which new spell ranks each variant adds. Earlier variants are inherited in full.
Hints.SpellheartMode: Predefined copies a complete PF2e spellheart from the selected compendia. Generated creates a new spellheart from one coherent, rules-style effect profile.
Hints.SpellheartProfile: A profile defines levels, prices, armor and weapon benefits, and spell structure as one balance unit. Effects from unrelated profiles are not freely mixed.
Hints.SpellheartTheme: The theme defines the spell pool and thematic damage or protection type. A fixed profile only offers compatible themes.
Hints.WandMode: Standard creates an ordinary single-spell wand. Special adds a rules-grounded modifier profile with its own level and price progression, so a matching special wand does not exist at every item level.
Hints.WandProfile: Choose a modifier profile or let Item Forge pick automatically from compatible profiles.
Hints.SpecificItemMode: Predefined copies a complete published item unchanged. Generated builds a new specific item on a normal weapon or suit of armor.
Hints.SpecificItemProfile: A profile keeps item level, price, fundamental runes, and the special ability together as one balance unit.
Hints.SpecificItemTheme: A fixed theme restricts selection to profiles and variants that explicitly support that theme.
Hints.SpecificItemRunes: For generated specific items, property runes come only from the profile. Fundamental runes remain normally upgradeable; additional property runes cannot be freely added.

Errors.NoBaseEquipment: No suitable non-specific base item was found in the selected compendiums.
Errors.UnsupportedEquipmentCategory: The “compose equipment” generation type supports only weapons, armor, and shields.
Errors.NoItemInLevelRange: No item matches the selected category and level constraint.
Errors.ItemDocumentNotFound: The selected item could not be loaded from its compendium.
Errors.InvalidPropertyRuneSelection: The selected property runes are incompatible with the base item, exceed available rune slots, or fall outside the allowed level/rarity constraints.
Errors.NoScrollSpellCandidate: No spell suitable for a scroll was found in the selected sources. Cantrips, focus spells, and rituals are excluded.
Errors.SpellDocumentNotFound: The selected spell could not be loaded from its compendium.
Errors.UnsupportedTreasureCategory: Treasure generation supports only categories under Treasure.
Errors.NoTreasureType: No registered treasure type matches the selected treasure category.
Errors.NoTreasureCandidate: No valid treasure could be generated with the selected material, condition, and value constraints.
Errors.UnknownTreasureContent: A requested treasure definition is not registered or is no longer available.
Errors.UnsupportedMagicCategory: This generation mode supports wands, staves, spellhearts, and specific magic weapons, armor, and shields.
Errors.NoWandSpellCandidate: No spell suitable for a wand was found in the selected sources.
Errors.NoStaffSpellCandidate: No suitable staff spell list could be assembled for the selected level and theme.
Errors.NoStaffBaseItem: The PF2e base weapon required for a staff could not be found.
Errors.NoPredefinedStaffCandidate: No predefined staff matching the requested level was found in the selected compendia.
Errors.UnknownStaffProfile: The selected staff family profile is not registered.
Errors.NoPredefinedSpellheartCandidate: No predefined spellheart matches the selected level, rarity, and source filters.
Errors.NoSpellheartTemplate: No PF2e spellheart was found to use as a structural template.
Errors.NoSpellheartSpellCandidate: The selected spellheart profile, theme, and sources do not provide enough suitable spells.
Errors.UnknownSpellheartProfile: The selected spellheart profile is not registered.
Errors.NoSpecialWandSpellCandidate: No spell compatible with this special wand profile was found.
Errors.UnknownWandProfile: The selected special wand profile is not registered.
Errors.NoPredefinedSpecificItemCandidate: No predefined specific item in the selected compendia matches the requested level.
Errors.NoSpecificBaseItem: No suitable non-specific base item was found in the selected sources.
Errors.NoSpecificProfileCandidate: No valid specific magic item could be generated for the requested level, profile, theme, and base item.
Errors.UnknownSpecificItemProfile: The selected specific magic item profile is not registered.
Errors.NoPredefinedSpecificShieldCandidate: No predefined specific magic shield in the selected compendia matches the requested level.
Errors.NoSpecificShieldBaseItem: No suitable mundane base shield was found in the selected sources.
Errors.NoSpecificShieldProfileCandidate: No valid specific magic shield could be generated for the requested level, profile, theme, and base shield.
Errors.UnknownSpecificShieldProfile: The selected specific magic shield profile is not registered.

Magic.GeneratedStaffDescription: This staff gathers magic around the theme “{theme}”. Its spell list was assembled from the selected spell sources to match the requested item level.
Magic.StaffActivation: Activate – Cast a Spell: Expend charges equal to the spell rank to cast a spell from the list. Cantrips expend no charges.
Magic.GeneratedStaffFamilyDescription: This staff belongs to a thematic variant family centered on “{theme}”. The selected variant also contains every spell introduced by the earlier variants in the family.
Magic.StaffFamilyProfileDescription: Family progression: {levels}. Each stronger variant adds new spell ranks rather than automatically filling every rank up to its maximum.

SpellheartText.ElementalDescription: A compact resonance core binds elemental magic to armor or weapon and channels the same energy through its spells.
SpellheartText.ElementalWeapon: After you cast a matching spell by activating this spellheart, Strikes with the affixed weapon deal an additional {weaponDamage} {damage} until the end of your next turn.
SpellheartText.SonicDescription: This vibrating resonator stores sonic magic and releases it as a protective counter-frequency or disruptive weapon pulse.
SpellheartText.SonicArmor: You gain resistance {resistance} to sonic damage and a +{saveBonus} item bonus to saves against auditory or sonic effects.
SpellheartText.SonicWeapon: After you cast a sonic spell by activating this spellheart, the affixed weapon stores resonance. Your next hit deafens the target for {weaponCondition}.
SpellheartText.VoidDescription: A dark shard gathers void energy and channels its weakening echo through its bearer or the affixed weapon.
SpellheartText.VoidArmor: You gain resistance {resistance} to persistent bleed damage and a +{saveBonus} item bonus to saves against effects with the void trait.
SpellheartText.VoidWeapon: After you cast a spell by activating this spellheart, Strikes with the affixed weapon deal an additional {weaponDamage} persistent bleed damage until the end of your next turn.
SpellheartText.VitalityDescription: This shimmering feather gathers life energy, bolstering its bearer against life-draining magic or lending vitalizing force to a weapon.
SpellheartText.VitalityArmor: You gain a +{saveBonus} item bonus to saves against death and void effects.
SpellheartText.VitalityWeapon: While the spellheart is affixed, the weapon gains the effect of the {rune} rune.
SpellheartText.SpellStatistics: Spells cast by activating this item use spell attack {spellAttack} and spell DC {spellDC}. When casting the cantrip, you can use your own spell attack modifier or spell DC instead if it is higher.
SpellheartText.AutomationNote: Attachment-specific armor and weapon benefits are stored as rules text. Item Forge deliberately does not copy Rule Elements from an unrelated published spellheart.
SpellheartText.DeafenedShort: 1 round (3 rounds on a critical hit)
SpellheartText.DeafenedMedium: 3 rounds (1 minute on a critical hit)
SpellheartText.DeafenedLong: 1 minute (1 hour on a critical hit)

WandText.ReachingDescription: This special wand extends the reach of its stored spell.
WandText.ReachingEffect: When you cast the stored spell, the activation takes 1 additional action if the spell normally takes 1 or 2 actions. Its range increases by 30 feet; a touch-range spell instead gains a range of 30 feet.
WandText.LegerdemainDescription: This special wand follows its stored spell with a conspicuous illusory performance.
WandText.LegerdemainEffect: After casting the stored spell, you can spend 1 action to create an illusory spotlight and harmless stage tricks. Enemies within 30 feet attempt a Will save against your spell DC; enemies recently threatened or treated with hostile actions gain a +4 circumstance bonus. On a failure they are fascinated with you until the end of your next turn. You can sustain the performance for up to 1 minute; hostile acts end the fascination, and the spotlight prevents you from being concealed and ends if you become invisible, attempt Stealth, or dismiss it.
WandText.MercyDescription: This special wand can make a suitable damaging spell nonlethal.
WandText.MercyEffect: When you cast the stored spell, the activation takes 1 additional action. You can give the spell the nonlethal trait for that casting.

SpecificItemText.RetributiveWeaponDescription: This specific magic weapon reacts to its bearer’s attackers and briefly imprints their threat into its magic.
SpecificItemText.RetributiveWeaponEffect: When a creature damages you with an attack, you gain a +{bonus} circumstance bonus to your next damage roll against that creature if you make that damage roll before the end of your next turn. If another creature damages you with an attack first, the retributive magic changes to that new attacker.
SpecificItemText.ElementalWeaponDescription: Bound elemental magic constantly resonates through this specific weapon. Its built-in property rune matches its element.
SpecificItemText.ElementalWeaponEffect: Activate – Discharge Resonance [free-action] (concentrate); Frequency once per day; Trigger You hit with this weapon; Effect The creature hit takes an additional {surgeDamage} {damageLabel}.
SpecificItemText.ElementalArmorDescription: This specific armor channels away one form of elemental energy and can condense its protection against a single impact.
SpecificItemText.ElementalArmorEffect: You gain resistance {resistance} to {damageLabel}. Activate [reaction] (concentrate); Frequency once per day; Trigger You would take {damageLabel}; Effect Double this armor’s resistance against the triggering damage.
SpecificItemText.GuardianArmorDescription: A defensive resonance worked into this armor hardens at the instant a blow is about to land.
SpecificItemText.GuardianArmorEffect: Activate [reaction] (concentrate); Frequency {frequency}; Trigger An attack would hit you; Effect You gain a +{acBonus} circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this turns the attack into a failure, it misses you.
SpecificItemText.PropertyRuneRestriction: As a specific magic item, this item can’t gain property runes that aren’t already part of its profile. Its fundamental runes can be upgraded or transferred normally.

SpecificShieldText.RestorativeDescription: Magical braces and self-mending bonds run throughout this shield.
SpecificShieldText.RestorativeEffect: Once per day, you can Activate the shield with 1 action (manipulate); it regains {repair} Hit Points.
SpecificShieldText.ElementalBastionDescription: Elemental magic is bound into the structure of this shield.
SpecificShieldText.ElementalBastionEffect: While the shield is raised, you gain resistance {resistance} to {damageLabel}.
SpecificShieldText.GuardianBulwarkDescription: This shield responds to its wielder’s movements and subtly realigns itself at a crucial moment.
SpecificShieldText.GuardianBulwarkEffect: {frequency}: When you Shield Block with this shield, you gain one additional reaction before the start of your next turn that can be used only to Shield Block.
SpecificShieldText.DurabilityNote: The listed Hardness, Hit Points, and Broken Threshold are intrinsic to this specific shield.
